raw_segments.text: but till more equality be established in society, till ranks are confounded and women freed,
we shall not see that dignified domestic happiness, the simple grandeur of which cannot
be relished by ignorant or vitiated minds. Nor will the important task of education
ever be properly begun till the person of a woman is no longer preferred to her mind.
For it would be as wise to expect corn from tares or figs from thistles
as that a foolish, ignorant woman should be a good mother.
